titre: Practice test — English (5th year primary) — Term 2

exercices.enonce:
Reading - Comprehension
Read the text then answer the questions.

Every Wednesday, Amira wakes up at six o'clock. She has a shower and gets dressed. She has breakfast at half past six. She walks to school at seven o'clock. In the afternoon, she plays basketball with her friends. In the evening, it is often cloudy, so she stays at home and paints pictures. She goes to bed at half past nine.

Questions:
1) What day does the text talk about? (1 pt)
2) What time does Amira wake up? (1 pt)
3) How does she go to school? (1 pt)
4) What sport does she play? (1 pt)
5) What is the weather like in the evening? (1 pt)
6) What time does she go to bed? (1 pt)

Telling the time
Write the time in words:
a) 6:00 ← ...
b) 6:30 ← ...
c) 7:00 ← ...
d) 9:30 ← ...

exercices.enonce:
Days and weather
Complete or match:
a) The day before Wednesday is ....... .
b) The day after Sunday is ....... .
c) When there are clouds, the weather is ....... .
d) When it is very hot and clear, the weather is ....... .

Grammar - Present simple
Complete with the correct verb:
a) She ....... (wake) up at six.
b) They ....... (play) basketball.
c) He ....... (paint) pictures.

Writing
Write 3 sentences about your Wednesday (what you do and at what time).
